title: Walsh basis on the sign cube
statement: For each natural number $n$, the Walsh characters indexed by subsets $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ form a basis over $\mathbb R$ for the space of real-valued functions on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$, where the character indexed by $S$ is $x\mapsto\prod_{i\in S}x_i$.
